meta.title: {name}’s baby shower
meta.description: Invitation to {name}’s baby shower. Confirm your RSVP and pick a gift.

event.subtitle: Our little artist is on the way
event.giftListFooter: Thank you for being part of this work of art

identify.title: Find your invitation
identify.lead: Enter your mobile number to see your list and confirm attendance.
identify.hint: If you cannot see your options, try the number of someone in your group (partner or family).
identify.pickLead: Choose your name within the group.

studio.clearChoicesBody: You will leave this session. The gift your group reserved will return to the list, and you can identify yourself again.

rsvp.title: Will you join us?
rsvp.lead: Let us know if you can be there on the day of the baby shower.
rsvp.savedNo: We saved that you cannot attend.

gifts.title: Gift list — {name}
gifts.lead: Your group can reserve one gift. If someone else took it first, pick another.
gifts.groupHasOne: Your group already reserved “{name}”. You can only choose one gift.
gifts.empty: There are no gifts available right now.
gifts.confirmReleaseBody: “{name}” will become available for other guests again.

audio.title: Celebration music
audio.missing: A song will live here soon. Add the file at public/audio/song.mp3.
audio.ready: Press play whenever you want to hear the song.

status.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
status.offline: We could not reach the invitation. Check your connection and try again.

admin.title: Baby shower panel
admin.loginLead: Only the host uses this screen.
admin.confirmReleaseBody: The group will be able to pick another gift, and this one returns to the list.
admin.emptyReserved: No gifts have been reserved yet.
admin.groupNameHint: If that name already exists for this type, they join that group.
admin.emptyGroupMembers: This group has no guests yet.
admin.groupTypeHint: Changing the type releases any gift this group had reserved.
admin.confirmDeleteGroupBody: Only empty groups can be deleted. Move or remove the people first.
admin.confirmDeleteBody: If they were the last person in the group, their gift returns to the list.
admin.emptyGroupType: There are no groups in this category yet.
